description:
Create a technical 'exploded view' animation for a product assembly. 

The scene contains a stacked device consisting of 4 parts (from bottom to top): Case_Bottom, Battery, Circuit_Board, and Case_Top. Currently, they are all collapsed at the origin.

Your task:
1. Create a starting keyframe at Frame 1 where the assembly is fully closed (current positions).
2. Animate the parts separating vertically (Z-axis) over 2 seconds (ending at Frame 48).
3. By Frame 48, there must be visible vertical gaps between all parts: Case_Top highest, then Circuit_Board, then Battery, then Case_Bottom.
4. Set the Scene End Frame to 60.
5. Render Frame 48 to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/exploded_view.png'.
6. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/exploded_view.blend'.
